main_text.p: ilio idipsum debito tempore non præ-staret, idque eo ipso sensu quo ab eis promissiones illas par erat juxta verborum enorem intelligi. Juravit{m} Deus, & non Ps.110.4 poenitebit eum. Juravit Dominus{n} Davi- Ps.132. veritatem, nec discedet ab ea.
main_text.head: SECT. VI.
main_text.p: Ratio tertia. Et natura Veritatis: prima est & potissima e tribus illis cantatissimis Juramenti conditionibus, quæ extant apud Jeremiam{o} prophetam, Jer.4. 2. ab omnibus inculcantur, & a Scholastis Tres juramenti Comites appellantur: Veritas sc. Judicium, & Justitia. Veritati repugnat, non modo quod [?]um est, sed & quod fictum est: nec mendacium solum apertum & nudum, opertum quoque & qualitercunque coloratum. Polluit certe verbum suum mendacio, quicunque falsum dixerit proximo suo: & falsum is dixisse pudus est proximo suo, per quem stetit ne falsus esset proximus suus ea ipse, nam ex dictis ipsius rationabiliter concludi erat. Quum ergo per istiusmodi sive generis simulationem non evitatur Mendacium, dummodo id nostrâ culpâ
Note: the left edge of the page is cropped by the binding, so the first letters of several lines are cut off; the words there are reconstructed from context and marked where uncertain.

page.notes: The left edge is cropped: the first line "ilio" and "taret", "enorem", "fum est", and other lines at the edge are partly hidden; "[?]um" is uncertain. Marginal mark "m" with Ps.110.4 and mark "n" with Ps.132. are beside the lines "Juravit Deus" and "Juravit Dominus". Mark "o" with Jer.4. 2. is beside "prophetam". The bare "II." in the right margin is a marginal number. The catchword "culpâ" is printed at the foot right; the signature is "D 3".
